purpose: legislators:PK:Sindh:general seats for constituencies PS-1 to PS-50
query: List the CURRENT members of the Provincial Assembly of Sindh (Sindh, Pakistan) holding the general seats for constituencies PS-1 to PS-50, as of 2026-11-15. For each member give full name, constituency code and name (for constituency seats), seat type (general, women_reserved, minority_reserved, other_reserved), party name and acronym, term start, whether the seat was won in a by-election, and source URLs that list this person as a member for this seat. Account for by-elections, deaths, resignations and disqualifications since the general election; omit vacant seats.
text: 48 current general-seat members are listed for PS-1–PS-50 as of 2026-11-15. PS-31 and PS-40 are omitted because the assembly’s current directory lists no holder for either. PS-9 and PS-30 were filled in by-elections. Term start is given as a year where the individual oath date was not reliably established.
